properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From the dev_storyflow agent sessions (art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27, the 2026-09-23 "Opportunity"), triaged 2026-09-28 on Anthony's word. The reporter's words: "a configured list of extra roots, e.g. `.reflow2/config: roots = [\"../storyflow\"]`". Filed after the third report that `link_artifact` on `../storyflow/...` records `not_measured: outside_root`. The cause is fact:root-cause-one-root-derived-from-the-stores-folder-leaves-a-sibling-repo-unmeasured-2026-09-28: a design has one measurement root, derived from the folder its store sits in.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) THE REPORTER'S: a list of extra roots in `.reflow2/config`, which is git-ignored and so per machine. measure.rs would accept a location that resolves under ANY listed root, not only the store's folder. Cheap, and it keeps the root bound: the operator lists the trees, and graph text still cannot direct a read anywhere else.
(b) THE SAME LIST IN THE COMMITTED POINTER, `.reflow2.toml` (#609), beside `[[also]]`. Discoverable and shared. ⚠️ Today the pointer REFUSES it by construction: measured on the branch's debug build, a `roots` key stops the session with "unknown field `roots`, expected `design` or `also`". `[[also]]` names DESIGNS with roles, not trees.
(c) NAMED roots instead of paths: `roots = { storyflow = "../storyflow" }`, and a location written `storyflow:src/x.rs`. The design then says WHICH tree, and only the machine says WHERE. This moves toward dec:idea-a-location-names-its-repository-or-an-archived-repo-is-relocated.
(d) SEVERAL `--tree-root` flags on the MCP entry. No new file, but it lives in each agent tool's own config, which reflow2 cannot read or check.

THE HONEST COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, recorded beside it:
· 🛑 A COMMITTED `../storyflow` IS ONE MACHINE'S LAYOUT WRITTEN INTO A SHARED FILE. req:the-design-knows-where-each-implementation-is says where a checkout sits "stays in that machine's configuration, never in the design". That favours (a) or (c) over (b).
· IT FIXES THE LOCAL CASE ONLY. On the hosted door every location answers `no_tree` (measured on a local registry of 0.72.0), so extra roots mean nothing there until the planned client measures local files (epoch:planned-local-files-are-measured-for-a-remote-design). That client is scoped to "a folder's OWN files", one root, so this idea would have to extend it.
· ANONYMOUS PATHS LEAVE THE ARCHIVE PROBLEM OPEN. Bare paths in a list do not say which repository a location belongs to, so wish #48 (a repository qualifier) is untouched unless the roots are named, as in (c).
· The dev_storyflow layout that prompted it is gone: dev_storyflow was archived 2026-09-27, and the code folder now names its design. The case recurs wherever a design's docs and code sit in different repositories, and cure's design may have two implementation repositories.

A RANKING IS A FINDING, NOT A DECISION: (c) is the only option that also answers the repository question, (a) is the cheapest, and (b) is refused by today's pointer.
properties.name: OPEN — should a design's files be measured under a configured list of extra roots (e.g. `roots = ["../storyflow"]`), so a design kept in one repository can baseline the code in its sibling?
properties.rationale: Recorded open because the measurement narrowed the cause to "one root, derived and unrecorded", and extra roots is the most direct answer to that. Whether the list is anonymous or named, per machine or committed, and whether it waits for the local client, are Anthony's calls. Idea: the dev_storyflow agent sessions. Options (b) to (d) and the counter-arguments: Claude Code, during the triage.
